# PAGE /about
Subora is a Nigerian marketplace where approved vendors sell shared subscriptions, online courses, software seats and other digital goods. Every payment is held in escrow until the buyer confirms that it works.

## What is Subora?

Many digital tools are priced for one person but can be shared safely between a few. Subora lets approved vendors sell those spare places, along with courses, templates and other digital goods, at a fraction of the usual price.

You pay from a wallet you fund yourself. Your money is held by Subora until you confirm that what you bought works. Only then is the vendor paid. It is the safety of a shop, with the prices of a shared plan. Anyone can browse the marketplace, and you only need an account to buy.

## Who is Subora for?

Subora is for buyers in Nigeria who want the lower price of a shared plan without the risk of paying a stranger, and for vendors who want a trusted place to sell spare places and digital products. Everything is priced in naira, and you can fund your wallet by card, bank transfer or USSD.

## What does Subora stand for?

- Escrow on every order. Your payment is held until you confirm that your access works.
- Vendors approved by hand. Vendors give identity documents and bank details, and every listing is reviewed before it goes live.
- Permanent records. Chats, wallet entries and dispute statements cannot be edited or deleted, so any problem can be traced and settled fairly.
- Plain fees. Buying is free. Vendors pay a 10% fee on each sale and a flat ₦100 per withdrawal.

## How does Subora make money?

Subora charges vendors 10% of each sale and a flat ₦100 for each withdrawal to a bank, plus a monthly marketing levy that pays for adverts that bring buyers to the marketplace. Buyers pay only the price shown on the listing. The full wording is in the Terms and Conditions.

## Where to read next

- How Subora works, from funding your wallet to confirming delivery
- Buying safely on Subora, including refunds and disputes
- Frequently asked questions
- Contact Subora

# PAGE /how-it-works
You fund a wallet, pick a listing, pay into escrow and confirm that your access works. The vendor is paid only after you confirm, or after 48 hours with no problem reported.

## How does buying on Subora work?

- Browse, then create a free account. Anyone can look through listings and compare prices. When you are ready to buy, sign up with your email and phone number and confirm with a one-time code.
- Fund your wallet. Add money by card, bank transfer or USSD. It is credited when the payment is confirmed.
- Pick a listing and read the vendor’s terms. Each vendor states what you get and the rules of use. You accept them before you pay.
- Pay into escrow. Your money is held, not sent. Your access appears on your subscription card.
- Confirm it works. The vendor is paid once you confirm, or after 48 hours with no problem reported.

## How do I get my login or code?

Many listings deliver automatically. A sign-in code or an access link arrives on your card within seconds, with no need to wait for the vendor. If you need a person, you can chat with the vendor before and after you buy. If they are away, you can send an urgent nudge by SMS and email, and Subora support steps in if there is still no reply.

## How do I fund my wallet?

Tap Fund wallet and pay by card, bank transfer or USSD. Your wallet is credited when the payment is confirmed. You pay for everything on Subora from this wallet, which is why you cannot pay a vendor directly: payments outside Subora have no escrow, no refunds and no dispute help.

## Can I buy more than one month at once?

Yes, on most subscriptions. You pick the plan length on the listing, and longer plans cost less per month.

## What can I buy on Subora?

Listings fall into a few simple groups. Prices are shown in Nigerian naira (₦).

- AI assistants. A private place on plans for chat, writing and image tools.
- Streaming and music. One screen or one seat on a family or premium plan.
- Design and software. Team seats for tools used at work and school.
- Courses and templates. Recorded lessons, project files, templates and content packs.
- Accounts and numbers. Aged social accounts and virtual numbers, with extra checks on every seller.

## How do I sell on Subora?

Vendors apply and are approved by hand. You give your identity documents and bank details, and each listing is reviewed before it goes live. Verified vendors unlock Pro tools. Sellers of gift cards, crypto and accounts need extra asset seller status. Vendors pay a 10% fee on each sale and a flat ₦100 per withdrawal, with a ₦2,000 minimum withdrawal.

Read how vendors are checked and the full Terms and Conditions.

# PAGE /safety
Subora holds your payment in escrow, checks every vendor by hand, and keeps a permanent record of every chat, payment and dispute, so problems can be settled fairly.
EscrowYour money is held until you confirm your access works
48 hoursFor a vendor to answer a refund request
By handEvery vendor is approved before they can sell
PermanentChats and payments cannot be edited or deleted

## How does escrow protect my money?

When you pay, Subora holds the money instead of sending it to the vendor. The vendor is paid once you confirm that your login, code or link works, or after 48 hours if you have not reported a problem. While you are checking your access, the vendor never holds your money.

## What if my access stops working?

Tap Report a problem on your subscription card. The vendor has 48 hours to respond, and your payment stays frozen in escrow while they do. A refund can be full, for the days you did not use, or a custom amount, and it goes back to your Subora wallet straight away. If you and the vendor disagree, Subora decides using the full chat and payment record, writes down the reason, and decides within 48 hours of both sides sharing their evidence. Read the full refund policy.

## How are vendors checked?

Vendors apply and are approved by hand. They give identity documents, a selfie and bank details before they can sell, and every listing is reviewed before it goes live. Payouts only go to a bank account in the vendor’s own verified name.

A blue tick marks a verified vendor who passed these checks. A gold tick marks a listing sold directly by Subora.

## How are gift card, crypto, account and number sellers checked?

These sellers carry more risk, so they have extra steps: identity verification, a video selfie, a proof of address and a ₦100,000 security deposit. Confirmed claims give a seller strikes. Three confirmed claims pause their listings, five suspend the account, and fraud closes it and uses the deposit to repay buyers. Claim windows are short and clear:

- Gift cards: report within 30 minutes of revealing the code, with a screenshot. The vendor has 2 hours to replace it or refund you, then Subora decides.
- Crypto: refunded in full if nothing arrives within 1 hour of payment, or if the wrong amount is sent.
- OTP numbers: refunded automatically if no SMS arrives within 20 minutes.
- Accounts: can be claimed within 24 hours of handover.

## How do I avoid scams on Subora?

- Pay only through Subora. Payments outside Subora have no escrow, no refunds and no dispute help.
- Report any chat message that asks you to pay or talk outside Subora. Those messages are hidden and reviewed.
- Subora staff never ask for your password, your codes or payment outside the app.
- Turn on two-step verification in your profile, so a new device, a withdrawal or a bank change needs a code sent to your phone.

## What are the third-party rules about shared accounts?

Subora is a marketplace: we provide the place where buyers and vendors meet, and we do not own, supply or control what vendors list. Some services, such as streaming, AI and software providers, have their own rules about sharing accounts or reselling access, and some do not allow it. Each vendor is responsible for checking those rules before listing. A provider can also change or end access at any time, and the refund rules then apply. See section 9 of the Terms and Conditions.

## I am a brand or rights holder. How do I report a listing?

Send us a rights holder notice. We review notices within 24 hours and pause the listing while we check. See how to contact us.

# PAGE /faq
Quick answers about buying, wallets, refunds, security and selling on Subora. If you cannot find yours, contact support.

## The basics

**Q: Is it safe to pay?**
A: Yes. Every payment is held in escrow. You confirm that your login, code or link works before the vendor is paid. If something breaks, you can report it and get a full or prorated refund.

**Q: How do I get my login or code?**
A: On your subscription card, usually within seconds. For many listings, sign-in codes and links are delivered automatically, so you never wait for the vendor.

**Q: Who sells on Subora?**
A: A small number of vendors approved by hand after identity checks. Subora also sells its own official listings.

**Q: What does it cost?**
A: Buying is free. You only pay the listing price from your wallet. Vendors pay a 10% fee on each sale.

**Q: What if the vendor does not reply?**
A: Tap Nudge vendor and they are alerted by SMS and email. If they still do not reply, Subora support steps in.

**Q: Can I delete my chats or payment history?**
A: No. Chats, payments and disputes are kept as permanent records so that any problem can be traced and settled fairly.

## Buying

**Q: How do I buy?**
A: Fund your wallet, open a listing, pick the plan length, tick that you have read the terms, and pay. Your access appears on your subscription card or order.

**Q: What is escrow?**
A: Your money is held by Subora until you confirm that access works, or 48 hours pass with no problem reported. Only then is the vendor paid.

**Q: Can I buy 3 or 6 months at once?**
A: Yes, on most subscriptions. Longer plans cost less per month.

## Wallet and payments

**Q: How do I fund my wallet?**
A: Tap Fund wallet and pay by card, bank transfer or USSD. Your wallet is credited when the payment is confirmed.

**Q: Why can’t I pay a vendor directly?**
A: Payments outside Subora have no escrow, no refunds and no dispute help. Chat messages that ask for outside payment are hidden and reviewed.

**Q: How do coupons work?**
A: Enter the code in your cart. Vendor codes only work on that vendor’s listings.

## Codes and access

**Q: How do I get a sign-in code?**
A: Sign in with the email on your subscription card, then tap Get sign-in code. The code arrives in seconds and works once.

**Q: The code didn’t come**
A: Wait two minutes and try again. If nothing arrives, the vendor is alerted automatically. You can also message them from the card.

## Gift cards, crypto and accounts

**Q: A gift card says it was already used**
A: Report it from the order within 30 minutes of revealing it, with a screenshot of the error. The vendor has 2 hours to send a new card or refund you, then Subora decides using the reveal log.

**Q: How is crypto delivered?**
A: You enter your own wallet address before paying. The vendor sends on-chain and adds the transaction ID. Payment is released only after the network confirms it.

**Q: My OTP number got no SMS**
A: If no SMS arrives within 20 minutes, your money goes back to your wallet automatically.

**Q: How are these sellers checked?**
A: They pass identity verification, a video selfie and a proof of address, and pay a security deposit. Confirmed claims give them strikes. 3 strikes pause them, 5 suspend them.

## Support and contact

**Q: When is support available?**
A: Chat support answers every day from 8am to 10pm (West Africa Time). Outside those hours, leave a message and we reply first thing.

**Q: How fast will I get a reply?**
A: Chat: usually within 15 minutes in support hours. Email: within 24 hours. Disputes are decided within 48 hours of both sides sharing their evidence.

**Q: The vendor is not replying**
A: Tap Nudge vendor in the chat. The vendor gets an SMS and email. If there is no reply in the time they set (1 to 8 hours), Subora support steps in.

**Q: I am a brand or rights holder**
A: Use the Rights holder notice link in the footer. The listing is paused while we check.

## Refunds and disputes

**Q: How do I get a refund?**
A: Tap Report a problem on the subscription card. The vendor has 48 hours to respond. If you disagree, Subora decides using the full record.

**Q: Are refunds prorated?**
A: Vendors can refund in full, for the days left, or a custom amount. Every refund is recorded in both wallets.

## Account and security

**Q: How do I turn on two-step verification?**
A: Go to My profile, then Security. With it on, logging in on a new device, withdrawing and changing bank details need a code sent to your phone.

**Q: I think someone else logged in**
A: Open My profile, log out all other devices and change your password. Then message support.

## Selling on Subora

**Q: Who can sell?**
A: Vendors apply and are approved by hand. Verified vendors unlock Pro tools. Gift card, crypto and account sellers need asset seller status.

**Q: What does it cost?**
A: 10% of each sale, a flat ₦100 per withdrawal and a monthly marketing levy. See the Terms.

## Still have a question?
Chat with support every day from 8am to 10pm West Africa Time.

## How can I contact Subora?

- Live chat: In the app, open the Help Centre and tap Chat with support
- Hours: 8am to 10pm West Africa Time, every day
- Typical reply: Within 15 to 30 minutes in chat hours
- Disputes: Decided within 48 hours of both sides sharing evidence

## What should I do if an order goes wrong?

Tap Report a problem on the subscription card for that order. The vendor has 48 hours to respond and your payment stays in escrow meanwhile. If the vendor does not reply, tap Nudge vendor in the chat: they are alerted by SMS and email, and Subora support steps in if there is still no answer. See how refunds and disputes work.

Subora staff never ask for your password, your codes or payment outside the app.

# PAGE /terms
These terms explain how buyers and vendors use Subora, how escrow and fees work, and what each side is responsible for.
Last updated 19 October 2026

## 1. Your account
You must give accurate details and keep your login private. You are responsible for all activity on your account. Vendors must complete identity verification to use Pro features.

## 2. Listings and resale rights
List only access, courses or files that you are allowed to resell. Stolen, illegal or unauthorised items are banned. Subora may reject, pause or remove any listing.

## 3. Payments, escrow and fees
Buyer payments are held in escrow until the buyer confirms access, or 48 hours pass with no dispute. Subora charges vendors 10% of every sale. On a ₦20,000 sale the vendor receives ₦18,000, and on a ₦10,000 sale the vendor receives ₦9,000. Each withdrawal to a bank costs a flat ₦100, with a ₦2,000 minimum.

## 4. Refunds and disputes
A refund request opens a case and freezes the escrow. The vendor has 48 hours to approve it or explain a decline. If they decline or do not reply, Subora support decides using the full record and writes down the reason.

## 5. Permanent records
Chats, wallet entries and dispute statements cannot be edited or deleted by buyers, vendors or staff. They are kept for as long as the law and dispute handling require.

## 6. Vendor marketing levy
Every vendor agrees that Subora will deduct a monthly marketing levy of ₦2,000 from the vendor’s available wallet balance on the 1st of each month. The levy pays for adverts that bring buyers to the marketplace. If the balance is too low on the due date, the amount is collected from the next earnings, and listings may be paused if it stays unpaid for 14 days. Subora will give 30 days’ notice before changing the amount.

## 7. Prohibited conduct
No fraud, harassment, taking payments outside Subora to avoid fees, or attempts to tamper with records.

## 8. Suspension and changes
Subora may suspend accounts that break these terms. We will tell you when the terms change.

## 9. Third-party rules and your responsibility
Subora is a marketplace. We provide the place where buyers and vendors meet, and we do not own, supply or control what vendors list. Many services, such as streaming, AI and software providers, have their own rules about sharing accounts, reselling access or using one plan across several people. Some of them do not allow it. Each vendor is solely responsible for checking those rules before listing, for having the right to sell what they list, and for any claim, loss, suspension, fine or legal action that comes from a listing. If a third party makes a claim about a listing, the vendor who listed it answers to that claim and agrees to cover Subora for any cost it faces because of it (an indemnity). Buyers should also know that a provider may change or end access at any time. When that happens, the refund rules in section 4 apply. Subora removes listings that it is told break a provider’s rules, and it may share vendor details with a rightful claimant or an authority when the law asks it to. Nothing here limits any right you have under the law.

# PAGE /privacy
This policy explains what personal data Subora collects, why we use it, who we share it with, and the rights you have over it.
Last updated 19 October 2026

## What we collect
Your name, email, phone number, orders, wallet activity, chats and the device you use. Vendors also give identity documents, a selfie and bank details for verification.

## Why we use it
To run your account and orders, hold payments in escrow, deliver codes, settle disputes, stop fraud and meet legal duties.

## Who we share it with
Payment processors (such as Paystack or Flutterwave) to move money, an identity-check provider for vendor verification, and messaging providers for WhatsApp, email and SMS alerts. Vendors see only what they need to deliver your order. We never sell your data.

## How long we keep it
Chats, wallet entries and dispute records are kept as permanent records for as long as the law and dispute handling require. Other data is deleted or anonymised when it is no longer needed.

## Your rights
You can ask to see, correct or export your data, and to delete what we are not required to keep, under the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023.

## Cookies
Essential cookies keep you logged in and your cart safe. Optional analytics cookies are used only if you accept them.

## Contact
Questions about your data: support@subora.com.ng.

# PAGE /refunds
If something you bought does not work, you can report it and get a full or prorated refund. This page shows the rules for each kind of listing.
Last updated 19 October 2026

## How do I get a refund?
Tap Report a problem on the subscription card. The vendor has 48 hours to respond. If you disagree, Subora decides using the full record. Every refund is recorded in both wallets. Read more about refunds and disputes.

## Subscriptions and seats
Report a problem from the card. The vendor has 48 hours to fix it or refund. Refunds can be full, or prorated for the days left.

## Courses and downloads
Refundable if the files don’t open or don’t match the description, reported within 48 hours.

## Gift cards
Report within 30 minutes of revealing the code, with a screenshot. The vendor has 2 hours to replace it or refund, then Subora decides.

## Crypto
Refunded in full if nothing arrives within 1 hour of payment, or if the vendor sends the wrong amount. Not refundable if you entered a wrong address.

## Accounts and OTP numbers
Accounts can be claimed within 24 hours of handover. OTP numbers refund automatically if no SMS arrives in 20 minutes.

## Where refunds go
Back to your Subora wallet straight away. You can spend it or ask support to send it to your bank.
